# Make the documentation tree human-readable and human-editable

[Task index](index.md) · [Previous](./deferred-harness-current-phase-history.md) · [Next](./docs.human-readable.architecture-development.md)

## Status

`deferred_between_children`: The first child docs.human-readable.contract-and-inventory is complete pending human acceptance. No child is active, automatic successor activation remains disabled, and every later child requires separate explicit activation after prerequisite acceptance.

## Objective

Establish docs/ as an ordinary human-authored, human-readable, human-editable documentation tree while relocating generated harness projections outside docs/ and preserving authoritative project, scientific, and historical content.

## Parent and prerequisites

None.

## Authority references

- AGENTS.md

## Authorized scope

- Coordinate seven serial child Tasks covering the documentation contract and inventory, generated-view separation, root navigation, architecture and development navigation, computational-document renaming, current-versus-history separation, and final cutover.
- Require every maintained docs/ page to be directly editable source, with obvious index-driven navigation and descriptive filenames, while keeping generated harness state outside docs/.
- Preserve scientific definitions, results, provenance, durable decisions, publication records, and Git history while changing documentation ownership, paths, navigation, and generated-view placement.

## Completion criteria

- All seven child Tasks are complete under their separately activated scopes, docs/ contains no generated harness projections, and human-authored documentation is readable directly from the repository checkout.
- Every first-level maintained documentation section has an obvious index, maintained links resolve, Sphinx passes with warnings as errors, and harness validation passes after generated-view relocation.
- The completed documentation contract states that ordinary prose edits use edit, documentation validation, review, commit, and push without harness synchronization.

## Exclusions

- Do not activate this parent or any child merely because this chain exists; do not enable automatic successor activation.
- Do not change scientific meaning, calculation inputs or results, dependencies, lockfiles, release state, publication claims, protected-execution authority, or execute scientific software.
- Do not delete retained evidence or historical material solely to simplify navigation; classify and preserve it under an explicit authoritative or historical owner.
